title: Viqu the Blindeye
summary: Viqu adds repeated arrow volleys during the lower half of the fight.
overview: Viqu adds repeated arrow volleys during the lower half of the fight.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Keep the group healthy before each potential volley.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: At 45% health, a 20-second timer begins checking for an arrow volley.
Successful checks fire at random hate-list targets; the script explicitly handles hate-list sizes from one through six.
Healing back through 45% or leaving combat stops the volley timer.

notes: Approval E279. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
Volley code has no branch for hate-list sizes above six; confirm intended raid behavior before publication.
Resolve the exact NPC template IDs from the zone database before enabling NPC-page links.
